title: "Measurement Plausibility Summary Report"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
output_dir <- Sys.getenv("REPORT_OUTPUT_DIR", unset = "../output")
output_dir <- normalizePath(output_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
report_title <- Sys.getenv("REPORT_TITLE", unset = "Measurement Plausibility Summary Report")
table_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "tables")
figure_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "figures")
metadata_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "metadata")

read_table <- function(name) {
  readRDS(file.path(table_dir, paste0(name, ".rds")))
}

input_summary <- read_table("input_summary")
age_band_distribution <- read_table("age_band_distribution")
gender_distribution <- read_table("gender_distribution")
global_method_ranges <- read_table("global_method_ranges")
global_consensus_range <- read_table("global_consensus_range")
strata_diagnostics <- read_table("strata_diagnostics")
stratified_ranges <- read_table("stratified_ranges")
contextual_model_summary <- read_table("contextual_model_summary")
classification_summary <- read_table("classification_summary")
row_level_results <- read_table("row_level_results")
```

# `r report_title`

## Overview

This report summarizes a one-off measurement plausibility analysis run from a value-frequency table stored in an Andromeda object.

```{r}
knitr::kable(input_summary)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(age_band_distribution)
```

### Representative Flagged Rows

```{r}
flagged <- row_level_results[
  row_level_results$finalClassification != "plausible",
  c("row_id", "age", "age_band", "gender_label", "care_site_id", "value", "frequency", "finalClassification")
]
knitr::kable(utils::head(flagged, 20))
```
